title: Approval Gateway for Model Rollouts with RBAC & Audit Trails
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Problem: As Redwood's model rollout surface grows (canaries, A/B, shadow), product teams need a formal, auditable, and enforceable approval process for production changes. Current rollouts rely on informal Slack approvals and per-team RBAC patterns; this leads to inconsistent gate enforcement, missing audit trails for compliance customers, and risk of incorrect model pushes during peak traffic.

Goal: Build an "approval gateway" service + Console integration that enforces required sign-offs, maps approvals to RBAC roles, records immutable audit logs, and ties into auto-rollback policies. The gateway will be used for: canary rollouts, A/B experiments, shadow traffic promotions, and full production swaps.

Scope: 
- RBAC: map Console roles (Admin, Release Engineer, SRE, Security Reviewer, Legal Reviewer) to approval capabilities.
- Approval types: single-signoff, multi-party (all reviewers must approve), and quorum-based (N-of-M).
- Audit logs: immutable event stream (who, when, what change, why) persisted for 1 year; exportable to customer KMS-enabled archive for Private customers.
- Workflow: create rollout -> select rollout policy (canary/A-B/shadow/instant) -> configure gates and sign-off requirements -> optionally schedule -> approvals required to advance to next stage.
- Integration: Console UI during rollout creation; REST API for automation; webhooks to notify approvers; GitHub PR automation (add required reviewers).
- Auto-rollback tie-in: define automatic rollback triggers (latency regression > 15% p95, error rate > 3%, quality drift on eval sets) and ensure rollback events are recorded in audit logs with linked sign-offs for manual overrides.

Non-goals: building a full feature flag system, replacing CI/CD pipelines, or redoing org-wide IAM.
acceptance_criteria: Console: rollout creation flow includes 'Approval requirements' panel with role selectors and signature mode (single/multi/quorum)
API: POST /rollouts accepts approval config; returns 409 if config requires roles that do not exist for the org
RBAC: only users with Release Engineer or Admin role can create rollouts that bypass manual approvals
Audit logs: every approval action (approve/reject/comment) is written to immutable audit stream with user id, timestamp, rollout id, and config snapshot
Auto-rollback: rollback event triggered by SLO breach is recorded and emits a 'rollback' audit event and optional required incident postmortem flow
E2E: simulated canary (10k requests) with injected regressions triggers both auto-rollback and notifies approvers via webhook
Export: Private deployments can configure audit export to a customer S3 bucket with KMS encryption
progress_updates: 2026-02-11 - Kickoff: agreed scope with ENG, Design, Security. Action: ENG to prototype audit event schema (ENG-2988)
2026-02-18 - Design review: DES provided wireframes for approval panel; requested clearer quorum UX and inline rationale field (DES-212)
2026-02-28 - Security review (initial): Security requested proof-of-writability and immutable storage for audit events; advised using signed event hashes
2026-03-03 - Engineering spike complete: prototype endpoint for approvals + event stream (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3214)
2026-03-08 - PM decision: require at least one SRE sign-off for rollouts that alter autoscaling or kernel configs; added to acceptance criteria
2026-03-12 - UX polish: added 'escalation' flow (auto-ping on no-answer after 48h) and emergency bypass restricted to Org Admins with 2FA confirmation
outstanding_risks: Audit storage costs for hosted customers could increase — need quota/retention settings defaulting to 90 days
Edge-case: conflicting approvals from multiple reviewers (one approves, one requests changes) — require explicit resolution UI
Private deployments have variable KMS integrations; export path must support S3, Azure Blob, and on-prem object stores
open_questions: Should approval events be cryptographically signed at creation to support tamper-evidence for regulated customers?
What SLA do we promise for approval webhook delivery (retry/backoff policy) and should it be exposed to customers?
How to surface historical approvals in Console when models are pinned across Dedicated pools with mixed tenancy?

implementation_notes: Store approvals as append-only events in Kafka + encrypted blob for snapshots
Expose approvals API with OpenAPI spec and SDK bindings (JS/Python/Go)
Console to store a display snapshot of role names to avoid confusion if org roles change after approval
